verdict.rationale: The data-integration docs index mentions "connectors for ingesting and exporting data" alongside stages, COPY INTO and Snowpipe. dbt Projects on Snowflake gives a documented first-party integration with one ELT/transformation tool, and Snowpipe covers file-based loading from stages. The evidence never names any SaaS-app or database source connectors, partner ETL/ELT tools, or their setup steps. missing for 10: named SaaS-app connectors, database/CDC source connectors, a partner ETL/ELT ecosystem (e.g. partner connect listings), documented per-connector setup guides, independent or hands-on corroboration.
